answer: Jury votes are weighted by the independent path length between reviewer and reviewed, and quorum holds only when seats span unrelated subnetworks. Two accounts funded from one source share a short path, so a packed panel of sparrows from the same branch carries near-zero weight and the votes cancel. What this cannot do is stop an operator who spends years building genuinely separate histories. An atlas of old review records is the entry price, and a comet of fresh identities arrives with no path length to spend.
